output.recommendation: A global domain-level policy recommendation could be: Establish a dedicated Cyber Emergency Response Team (CERT) under an umbrella organization that includes representatives from telecom regulators, crisis authorities, and industry stakeholders. This team would coordinate responses to AI-driven critical telecom network failures during emergencies, ensuring clear lines of responsibility and effective coordination.
output.rationale: [G1] EU-NIS2-2022 Article 1(2)(a) underscores the need for designated competent authorities and cyber crisis management authorities in cybersecurity incidents. By creating a CERT that integrates these roles, we can address the gap of unclear responsibility when AI causes public emergencies affecting telecom networks.
